phases.name: WXT protocol and transports
evidence: CI run 44953304877 passed: npm install, WXT prepare/typecheck, Vitest, Chrome MV3 build, Firefox desktop MV3 build and Firefox Android MV2 build. Protocol sync against VortexDM also passed. Mock native-host handshake and chunk round-trip E2E remain pending.

Commit 9ac565c adds mock-host ConnectionManager handshake, correlation, explicit rejection ACK, large-batch chunk ACK and missing-response tests. Actual browser Native Messaging host E2E remains pending.

phases.name: Download interception
evidence: Pure rule engine and TTL header cache added; cross-browser E2E pending.
Commits 37565ab/4749689 normalize domain, MIME and extension rules; commits 3d9e7d7/f18420c add a 30+ case capture policy matrix. Host-unavailable browser E2E remains pending.

phases.name: Media, extraction and privacy filtering
evidence: Built-in filter engine and Ghostery integration compile and pass current unit/build pipeline; filter update/cache tests and browser E2E pending.
Android filtering is delegated to original Raymond Hill uBlock Origin installed from Mozilla Add-ons in Firefox for Android; Bridge Android remains download handoff.
Commit f27ef83 disables Bridge's adblock controller on Firefox for Android and exposes official Mozilla uBO installation instead; CI pending.
Commit 12b40ac removes the cookie collection prompt and sends no session cookies; authenticated media extraction remains unsupported until a secure ephemeral cookie handoff is implemented.
Commit 76ef69d removes all cookie collection/forwarding from background media extraction; public-only URL/title requests remain, while authenticated media support and E2E are pending.

phases.name: Content scripts and batch grabber
evidence: Closed Shadow DOM, scanner and Ghostery cosmetics bridge compile in all three browser targets.
Commits 6307584 and 195db4b add keyboard actions and queue-aware batch grabber selection.

phases.name: Popup options and distribution
evidence: Settings UI, full-filter opt-in and Android Firefox build target compile; device and store validation pending.
User-supplied VortexDM artwork configured as WebExtension manifest and toolbar action icon; commit 4fd04a3.
Commit e6c784a persists interception settings and applies them to the background download decision engine.

Commit 970127a resets Android HTTP transport connection state after request failures; test suite aa7dbe4 covers health auth, API key, IPC request, server failure and reconnect. Execution remains deferred until final validation.
Commit 76ef69d ensures the background never reads or forwards browser cookies for extraction. Commit 10273fb in VortexDM adds the Android 10+ MediaStore export used by completed tasks.

VortexDM commit 6ca522b provides Windows/Linux Native Messaging registration and uninstall scripts; Bridge docs/INSTALLATION.md (6f15acc) documents the browser build and matching host registration. Manual browser install/E2E still pending.
